title: 第1章  被仙子束缚
content_zh:
“宗，宗主，你，你这是要干什么？”
昏暗的山洞中，苏烬生紧贴身后墙壁，眼中满是疑惑之色出声。
他乃是紫幕神山的一名杂役弟子，原本正在砍柴，却被宗主突然劫持到这昏暗的山洞中。
“少废话，快把衣服脱了！”
南宫明月眉头紧皱，历喝出声之后，倾城绝色的脸上露出一抹羞红。
想她堂堂紫幕神山宗主，却在搜寻天材地宝之时，遭受歹人陷害，身中合欢散剧毒。
虽费劲全力逃出生天，却也错过了祛毒最佳时间。
若是不能及时解除毒性，将会气血逆行，灵气混乱，轻则丹田筋脉受损，重则当场暴毙身亡。
为了活下去，便只能便宜苏烬生了！
“什么！？”
苏烬生双目瞪大，仿佛听到了什么惊骇世俗的言语一般，满脸不可思议的神色。
昏暗山洞！人烟稀少！还要他脱衣服！
这用脚指头想都知道，这宗主想要干什么！
可是，在他的记忆之中，宗主一向冷若冰清，怎会想要和他在山洞之中做这种事情！
“这，这不好吧宗主，我可还是童子之身啊！”
虽然南宫明月绝色貌美，柔弱无骨，任谁看了都会心动，把持不住！
但他也不是傻子，这种天大好事怎么会突然落到他身上呢？
一定有诈！
说不定，宗主暗地里修炼了双修之法，找他当鼎炉呢！
虽说是贱命一条，但也不愿就此被榨干啊！

南宫明月脸上一阵发烫，羞红到了耳朵根后，全身炽热，若是再不及时解毒，将会损及筋脉。
当即，绝色双眸中闪过一缕厉色。
“真是啰嗦！”
“刺啦……”
苏烬生只感觉身子一轻，低头望去，已无半点遮身衣物。
还未等他反应过来，南宫明月便褪去全身衣物，如饿虎扑食一般朝他扑去！
暖玉入怀，淡淡香气入鼻，耳边，吐气如兰，苏烬生心中欲火瞬间被点燃。
这，这谁能把持得住啊？
心中暗道一声之后，苏烬生便彻底沉沦其中。
“宗主……你好香啊……”
“……”
一个时辰后，苏烬生身影紧贴石壁，眼睛时不时的瞟向宗主，不知接下来该如何是好。
若是一年前的话，他还能对宗主负责，但是如今，他不过是杂役弟子罢了。
原本他乃是一名孤儿乞丐，为了能够吃饱穿暖加入紫幕神山，成为了杂役弟子。
从杂役弟子到内门弟子第一人，他用了五年时间，又用了一年时间，从内门弟子干到了杂役弟子！
其中缘由乃是因为他一年前无意中得到了一颗神秘种子。
他以为是什么奇异宝物，便用灵气试探一番，谁曾想，神秘种子直接进入丹田内，肆意的吞噬其中灵气。
仅一年时间，他便从聚灵九重境，跌到了炼气一重境。
天源大陆境界划分为炼气境，聚灵境，归元境，宗师境，大宗师境，炼虚境，洞虚境，破虚境……
今天是他成为杂役弟子的第一天，被分配到砍柴的杂活。

谁曾想，就被宗主掠夺到这山洞中，夺了贞洁。
不会是宗主为了鼓励他修炼，特意给他缓解压力的吧！
毕竟，他曾经可是紫幕神山最耀眼的天才，如今却沦落至此，心中压力必然山大。
作为宗主最看好的弟子，这样做，也不是没有可能。
苏烬生思索间，把被撕扯成布条的衣服往身上拉扯了下，遮掩身躯。
不管了！
反正这事是宗主主动的，跟他也没有什么关系，大不了不用宗主负责就是了。
一旁，南宫明月双眸微闭，盘腿而坐，体内剧毒早已解开。
但一想到刚才那近乎疯狂的行动后，她不知道该如何面对苏烬生，便一直盘坐原地。
要知道，当初苏烬生可是她最看好的弟子，也曾数次出面指点。
包括苏烬生境界跌落后，她也是带着苏烬生访遍师友，查明原因。
在她看来，苏烬生不过是小辈罢了，就算是她徒弟，都要比苏烬生大上百岁！
然而，如今却是发生了这种荒唐事情！
“呼……”
一口浊气缓缓吐出，南宫明月缓缓睁开双眼，面色冰冷，翻手间取出一身衣物丢到了苏烬生面前。
“把衣服穿上！”
苏烬生连忙蹑手蹑脚穿上衣服，眼神瞟了一眼宗主，随即又迅速移开。
“咳咳……”
“宗主你放心，我不用你负责，也绝不泄露此事半个字！”
“那个，宗主你还有需要吗？没有的话，我就要去砍柴了！”

“毁了我的清白还想要一走了之？”
南宫明月秀眉轻皱，面色阴沉了下来，但随着一道精光闪过眼眸，面色恢复冰冷，厉声道。
“告诉你！若敢不对我负责，我便杀了你这个负心汉！”
苏烬生一脸愕然的愣在原地，不是，这不是你强迫做的的吗？
跟老子有什么关系？
不过，当他看到地面白衣上的一抹嫣红时，心中也是诧异万分。
宗主实力强悍，至少存活数百年之久，竟然还未尽人事？
那刚才怎么会那般饥渴？
“若不是我身中剧毒，又怎会便宜了你？”
南宫明月见到其这般眼神，也是猜到了其在想些什么，当即便出声道。
“还有，我并非你宗主”
闻言，苏烬生顿时恍然大悟，再联想起事前女子那迷离的眼神，的确是中毒的征兆。
如此说来，还真是便宜他了！
但紧接着便露出一副诧异之色，开口出声道。
“你不是我们宗主！”
“这怎么可能？”
南宫明月眼神冰冷，神情冷漠，继而出声问道。
“你口中的宗主是不是紫幕神山的宗主，名为南宫明月！”
“是啊！”
苏烬生眉头紧锁，心中疑惑之色更加浓郁，开口回答出声。

“我名南宫问月，乃是你宗主的双胞胎妹妹，如今乃是圣地弟子！”
南宫明月神情不变，仿佛只是在述说实情一般，然而，心中却是暗道。
妹妹，只能先拿你当挡箭牌了！
苏烬生心中大吃一惊，随即便想起，先前宗主好像的确跟他提起过有一个双胞胎妹妹，但也只提过一句而已，并未多说。
想到这里，苏烬生目光上下扫视一番，她，他不会真的是宗主的妹妹吧。
好像的确有点不一样。
“好吧，我还以为你是宗主呢！”
“不过，我如今已经十七岁，却还只是炼气一重境的小喽啰而已！”
“如何配得上你啊？”
女人都慕强，都会选择实力比自己强大的修炼者为道侣。
又怎会选择小喽啰作为道侣呢？
南宫明月见苏烬生相信，心中不由得暗自松了口气，面色却依旧冷若冰霜，言语犀利！
“少废话！”
“五年后来烈阳圣地娶我，若敢不来，就算跑遍天涯海角，我也要将你砍了你的脑袋！”
说完之后，便丢出一个镶有紫色晶石的戒指，继而厉声道。
“这乃是储物戒，里面有炼气境所需要的修炼资源，可供你突破境界！”
苏烬生接过戒指，眼中满是惊喜之色，这储物戒可是极其珍贵之物，价值千金。
先前他也曾有一个，可惜因为境界跌落，被其他弟子抢走了。
他将储物戒收好，脸上露出一抹笑意，如此懂事的貌美娇妻，娶她似乎也不亏呀。
“多谢仙子姐姐！”

“五年后，我苏烬生一定去烈阳圣地娶你！”
虽然他如今无法修炼，但谁知道五年后又是如何呢？
还是先将眼下的难关过了再说，他感觉若是不答应的话，南宫问月可能真会砍他的脑袋。
南宫明月闻言，面色才缓和几分，随即边起身边开口道。
“听着，你的未婚妻叫南宫问月！”
“我在烈阳圣地等你！”
说完之后，身影闪烁，几个迈步间便已消失在了山洞中。
她实在无法面对这个与自己发生关系的少年了，所以要尽快离开。
至于让其去烈阳圣地娶妻，也不过是为了激励苏烬生修炼罢了。
反正，就算是苏烬生的天赋恢复，也不可能接触到圣地那等庞然大物。
南宫问月？
这名字真是霸气！
长得和宗主也是真像！
苏烬生望着未婚妻的身影，嘴角翘起了丝丝弧度，心中暗道出声。
“砰！”
一股微弱的气息从体内迸发！
晋级，炼气二重境！
苏烬生微微一愣，当察觉到体内变化后，如遭雷击一般愣在原地。
要知道，他已经一年都未曾突破过境界了，突如其来的变化让他感到不可思议！
抑制心中激动，神识进入丹田中。

只见一个拳头大小的褐色种子绽放荧光，一缕嫩芽冒出，清晰可见。
这，这种子是怎么回事？
他记得昨日还是黯淡无光，未曾发芽呀！
还有，这种子非但不再吞噬丹田内的灵气，反而自动将外面的灵气吞噬体内。
被吞入丹田的灵气在神秘种子周围环绕一圈之后，流入筋脉，粗润强化体质！
恢复了！
一切都恢复了！
苏烬生双目红润，嘴唇颤抖，激动之心犹如惊涛骇浪一般翻涌。
这一年来，他受尽屈辱，任谁都想踩一踩他这个曾经的内门弟子第一人。
似乎这样能够满足那些人的虚荣心一样。
或许是他们曾在苏烬生的面前卑躬屈膝过，故而在其落魄后，想要找回尊严吧。
苏烬生双拳骤然紧握，一缕气息从身上爆发，双眸展露凶光，言语中满是恨意。
“姜紫嫣，真想知道，若是你得知我丹田恢复之后，会是何等表情！”
当初从神坛跌落，所有人的言语侮辱他都能够忍受。
唯独姜紫嫣的冷眼旁观，视若陌生般的举动让他心痛万分。
因为这些年来，姜紫嫣一直追随在他身边，获益无数，地位也是水涨船高。
见他无利用价值之后，便撇清关系，不再相见。
着实让他感受到了人情冷暖，世态炎凉！
但自今日起，他便能够重新修炼，突破境界！
依靠神秘种子自动吞噬灵气，他日后修炼速度至少是别人的两倍！

而且，神秘种子所吞噬的精纯灵气可滋润体质，无时不刻的强化力量，这对他来说，受益无穷！
即便他已经十七岁错过了最佳的修炼年龄，但凭借他的天赋以及神秘种子。
重登巅峰，是必然的事情！
“苏烬生！给老子滚出来！别以为躲到山洞中我就找不到你了！”
content_en:
"Zong, sect master, you, what are you going to do?"
In the dim cave, Su Jinsheng clung to the wall behind him, his eyes filled with doubts as he spoke.
He was a handyman disciple of the Purple Curtain Mountain. He was chopping firewood when he was suddenly abducted by the sect master into this dark cave.
"Stop talking nonsense and take off your clothes quickly!"
Nangong Mingyue frowned, and after Li shouted, a blush appeared on Qingcheng's stunning face.
I miss her, the majestic leader of the Purple Curtain Mountain, but when she was searching for heavenly materials and earthly treasures, she was framed by a gangster and was poisoned by Hehuan Powder.
Although he tried his best to escape, he also missed the best time to detoxify.
If the poison cannot be removed in time, the qi and blood will flow backwards, the spiritual energy will be chaotic, and the Dantian tendons and veins will be damaged at worst, and death will occur on the spot.
In order to survive, she had no choice but to take advantage of Su Jinsheng!
"What!?"
Su Jinsheng's eyes widened, as if he heard some words that shocked the world, with an incredible look on his face.
Dark cave! Sparsely populated! Make him take off his clothes!
You can use your toes to figure out what this sect leader wants to do!
However, in his memory, the sect leader has always been as cold as ice. How could he want to do such a thing with him in the cave!
"This, this is not good, Master, I am still a child!"
Although Nangong Mingyue is stunningly beautiful, weak and boneless, anyone who looks at it will be moved and unable to control it!
But he is not a fool. How could such a great thing happen to him suddenly?
There must be some fraud!
Maybe the sect master has secretly practiced the method of dual cultivation and asked him to be the cauldron!
Even though it’s a lowly life, I don’t want to be squeezed out of it!
Nangong Mingyue's face felt hot, and the blush reached behind her ears. Her whole body was burning. If the poison was not detoxified in time, her muscles and veins would be damaged.
Immediately, a stern look flashed in his stunning eyes.
"What a verbose thing!"
"Stab it..."
Su Jinsheng felt his body light up, and when he looked down, he saw that there was no longer any clothing covering his body.
Before he could react, Nangong Mingyue took off all his clothes and pounced on him like a hungry tiger pouncing on food!
Warm jade entered his arms, and the faint fragrance entered his nose and ears. His breath was like orchid, and the desire in Su Jinsheng's heart was instantly ignited.
This, who can control this?
After thinking secretly in his heart, Su Jinsheng was completely immersed in it.
"Sect Master...you smell so good..."
"..."
An hour later, Su Jinsheng's figure clung to the stone wall, his eyes glancing at the sect master from time to time, not knowing what to do next.
A year ago, he would still be responsible to the sect master, but now, he is just a handyman disciple.
He was originally an orphan beggar. In order to have enough food and clothing, he joined the Purple Curtain Mountain and became a handyman disciple.
It took him five years to go from being a handyman disciple to becoming the number one disciple among the inner sect, and another year to go from being an inner sect disciple to becoming a handyman disciple!
The reason is because he accidentally obtained a mysterious seed a year ago.
He thought it was some strange treasure, so he tested it with spiritual energy. Who would have thought that the mysterious seeds directly entered the Dantian and devoured the spiritual energy in it wantonly.
In just one year, he fell from the ninth level of spirit gathering to the first level of qi refining.
The realms of Tianyuan Continent are divided into Qi Refining Realm, Spirit Gathering Realm, Yuan Yuan Realm, Grandmaster Realm, Grand Master Realm, Void Refining Realm, Cave Void Realm, and Void Breaking Realm...
Today was his first day as a handyman disciple, and he was assigned to the chore of chopping wood.
Who would have thought that he would be robbed by the sect master into this cave and take away his virginity.
Could it be that the sect leader specifically relieved his stress in order to encourage him to practice?
After all, he was once the most dazzling genius in the Purple Curtain Mountain, but now that he has fallen to this level, he must be under great pressure.
As the most promising disciple of the sect master, it is not impossible to do this.
While Su Jinsheng was thinking, he pulled the clothes that had been torn into strips of cloth over his body to cover his body.
No matter!
Anyway, it was the sect leader who took the initiative and had nothing to do with him.What does it matter? The big deal is that the sect leader is not responsible.
On the side, Nangong Mingyue closed her eyes slightly and sat cross-legged. The poison in her body had long been released.
But when she thought of the almost crazy action just now, she didn't know how to face Su Jinsheng, so she kept sitting cross-legged.
You know, Su Jinsheng was her most promising disciple at the beginning, and he had come forward to give guidance several times.
Even after Su Jinsheng fell, she took Su Jinsheng to visit his teachers and friends to find out the reason.
In her opinion, Su Jinsheng is just a junior. Even her apprentice is hundreds of years older than Su Jinsheng!
However, now this ridiculous thing has happened!
"Huh..."
Slowly exhaling a breath of turbid air, Nangong Mingyue slowly opened her eyes, with a cold expression on her face. She took out a set of clothes and threw them in front of Su Jinsheng.
"Put your clothes on!"
Su Jinsheng quickly put on his clothes quietly, glanced at the sect leader, and then quickly moved away.
"Ahem..."
"Don't worry, Sect Master, I don't need you to be responsible, and I will never reveal a word about this matter!"
"Well, Master, do you need anything else? If not, I'm going to chop wood!"
"You ruined my innocence and want to walk away?"
Nangong Mingyue frowned slightly and her expression became gloomy, but as a flash of light flashed through her eyes, her expression returned to coldness and she said sternly.
"I'm telling you! If you dare not be responsible for me, I will kill you, the heartless man!"
Su Jinsheng froze on the spot with a look of astonishment. No, wasn't this forced by you?
What does it have to do with me?
However, when he saw a flash of red on the white clothes on the ground, he was also extremely surprised.
The sect leader is very powerful and has survived for at least hundreds of years, but he still hasn’t finished his duties?
Then why were you so hungry just now?
"If I hadn't been poisoned, how could I have taken advantage of you?"
When Nangong Mingyue saw his eyes like this, she guessed what he was thinking and immediately spoke out.
"Also, I am not your sect master."
Hearing this, Su Jinsheng suddenly realized that the woman's confused eyes before the incident were indeed a sign of poisoning.
In this way, he is really cheap!
But then he showed a look of surprise and spoke.
"You are not our sect leader!"
"How is this possible?"
Nangong Mingyue's eyes were cold and her expression was indifferent, and then she asked aloud.
"Is the sect master you are talking about the sect master of the Purple Curtain Mountain? His name is Nangong Mingyue!"
"Yes!"
Su Jinsheng frowned, the doubts in his heart became more intense, and he opened his mouth to answer.
"My name is Nangong Wenyue, I am your sect leader's twin sister, and now I am a disciple of the Holy Land!"
Nangong Mingyue's expression remained unchanged, as if she was just telling the truth. However, there was a secret thought in her heart.
Sister, I can only use you as a shield first!
Su Jinsheng was shocked, and then he remembered that the sect leader did indeed mention to him that he had a twin sister before, but he only mentioned it once and didn't say much more.
Thinking of this, Su Jinsheng glanced up and down. She, he couldn't really be the sect master's sister.
It does seem a little different.
"Well, I thought you were the sect leader!"
"However, I am seventeen years old now, but I am still just a young man in the first level of Qi refining!"
"How can I be worthy of you?"
Women all admire strength and will choose practitioners who are stronger than themselves as their Taoist companions.
How could he choose a young man as a Taoist companion?
Seeing that Su Jinsheng believed it, Nangong Mingyue couldn't help but secretly breathed a sigh of relief, but her face was still as cold as ice and her words were sharp!
"Cut the nonsense!"
"Marry me in the Burning Sun Holy Land in five years. If you dare not come, I will chop off your head even if I travel to the ends of the earth!"
After he finished speaking, he threw out a ring set with purple crystal stones, and then said sternly.
"This is a storage ring. It contains the cultivation resources needed for the Qi Refining Realm, which can be used for you to break through the realm!"
SuJinsheng took the ring, his eyes full of surprise. This storage ring is an extremely precious thing, worth thousands of gold.
He had one before, but it was a pity that it was snatched away by other disciples due to his decline in realm.
He put the storage ring away with a smile on his face. It seemed that marrying such a sensible and beautiful wife was not a bad idea.
"Thank you Fairy Sister!"
"In five years, I, Su Jinsheng, will definitely go to the Holy Land of Lieyang to marry you!"
Although he can't practice now, who knows what it will be like in five years?
It was better to get over the current difficulty first. He felt that if he didn't agree, Nangong Wenyue might really chop off his head.
When Nangong Mingyue heard this, her expression softened a little, and then she stood up and spoke.
"Listen, your fiancée's name is Nangong Wenyue!"
"I'll wait for you at the Holy Land of the Fierce Sun!"
After saying that, the figure flickered and disappeared into the cave in a few steps.
She really couldn't face this boy who had a relationship with her, so she wanted to leave as soon as possible.
As for letting him go to Lieyang Holy Land to get a wife, it was just to encourage Su Jinsheng to practice.
Anyway, even if Su Jinsheng's talent is restored, it is impossible to come into contact with such behemoths as the Holy Land.
Nangong Wenyue?
This name is really domineering!
He looks exactly like the sect leader!
Su Jinsheng looked at his fiancée's figure, the corners of his mouth curled up slightly, and he secretly said in his heart.
"Bang!"
A weak breath bursts out from the body!
Advance to the second level of Qi refining!
Su Jinsheng was stunned for a moment. When he noticed the changes in his body, he froze in place as if struck by lightning.
You know, he has not broken through the realm for a year, and the sudden changes made him feel incredible!
Suppress the excitement in your heart and enter your dantian with your spiritual consciousness.
I saw a fist-sized brown seed blooming with fluorescence, and a wisp of buds emerged, clearly visible.
What's going on here?
He remembered that yesterday it was still dim and dull, and it had not sprouted yet!
Also, this seed not only no longer swallows the spiritual energy in the Dantian, but also automatically swallows the spiritual energy outside the body.
The spiritual energy swallowed into the Dantian circulates around the mysterious seeds and then flows into the veins, thickening and strengthening the body!
Restored!
Everything is restored!
Su Jinsheng's eyes were red, his lips were trembling, and his excitement surged like a stormy sea.
